title: A cover has no fixed minimum length
text: A cover has no fixed minimum length (replaces "covers >= 4 s"; HKS-21 confirmed): it lasts as long as the words that point at it, and sits on the footage at the moment the speaker talks about it. Look for the broadcast's split screens first; that footage may cover a cut when it is on the topic, or when the broadcast was showing it at that moment.

source.heading: Confirmed by the user (2026-11-24, answers to the overnight study's questions)

confirm: For each cover, which words point at it, and is it on the topic or what the broadcast showed then?
